preconditions.description: The number of queries is between 1 and 10.
The number of nodes is between 2 and 1000.
The number of edges is between 1 and n*(n-1)/2.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for all u, v in edges
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two valid nodes.
The starting node is a valid node.

postconditions.description: The output array contains n-1 elements.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(d, int) for d in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each element in the output array is an integer.

postconditions.expression: all(d == -1 or d % 6 == 0 for d in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each distance is either -1 or a multiple of 6.

postconditions.expression: return_value[i] == -1 if i + 1 not in reachable_nodes else return_value[i] == min_distance[i + 1] * 6
postconditions.description: The distance to node i+1 is -1 if it is unreachable, otherwise it is the minimum distance times 6.
